decision_checks.rule: Starts only from the v3.5.3 non-authorizing draft-review output.

Reviewer can route forward, hold, return, or block without granting permission.
Execution, storage writes, canonical updates, migrations, accounts, secrets, public release, and production stay closed.
Forward movement can only prepare the founder decision gate, never a runnable authorization.
Hold, return, block, and expiry expose clear reasons before local save or copy.
Expires on draft review, source, rights, founder, rollback, monitoring, packet, or code change.
